summary: Agent cards and assistant roster counts use the shared harness freshness window so healthy idle and ready agents stay current between five-minute reports

replay.detail: Read-time presentation only; no claim replay or recovery changes.

schema.detail: No schema, indexes, data rewrites or client contract changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Real harness observations remain current for the shared 330-second window. Missing observations, suspended seats and harnessless services retain their existing presentation. The separate no-session liveness grace period is unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; no additional startup work.

manual.detail: No configuration changes or operator actions required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions.
